name: Orphaned surveyor
description: An audit machine that counts allocations as deliveries. It still treats an unpaid household as an empty address.

name: Wirejack
description: An autonomous salvage machine that treats anything outside a paid inventory as scrap, including working public equipment. It is a machine, not a human salvager.

name: Debt warden
description: An armored collector enforcing Continuance’s inherited claims. Its orders can outlive the office that issued them.
